Package index

Fitting

thiessen()
Fit an AddiVortes model
thiessen_control()
Configuration of a fit

Outcome families

gaussian_outcome()
The Gaussian outcome family
probit_outcome()
The binary probit outcome family
print(<thiessen_outcome>)
Print an outcome family

Experimental outcome families

Compiled only into a core built with its experimental feature; see experimental_outcomes.

tobit_outcome() experimental
The tobit outcome family
aft_outcome() experimental
The accelerated failure time outcome family
interval_censored_outcome() experimental
The interval-censored outcome family
ordinal_outcome() experimental
The ordinal outcome family
student_t_outcome() experimental
The Student-t outcome family
laplace_outcome() experimental
The Laplace outcome family
experimental_outcomes
Outcome families behind the core's experimental feature

Parameter groups

term_params()
One ensemble of tessellations
geometry_params()
The covariate space of the ensembles
structure_params()
The covariate-inclusion prior of the ensembles
cell_params()
The within-cell response surface of the ensembles
general_params()
The sweep schedule of a fit
print(<term_params>) print(<geometry_params>) print(<structure_params>) print(<cell_params>) print(<general_params>)
Print a parameter group
print(<thiessen_control>)
Print a control object

Experimental component options

Values of the parameter groups compiled only into a core built with its experimental feature; see experimental_outcomes for the policy.

soft_membership() experimental
Soft membership of observations in cells
weighted_inclusion() experimental
Fixed inclusion weights over the covariates
dart_inclusion() experimental
The DART sparsity prior over the covariates
print(<thiessen_option>)
Print a component option

Fitted-model methods

predict(<thiessen>)
Posterior predictions from a fitted model
fitted(<thiessen>) residuals(<thiessen>) nobs(<thiessen>)
Fitted values, residuals and observation count of a fitted model
sigma(<thiessen>)
Residual standard deviation of a fitted model
summary(<thiessen>) print(<summary.thiessen>)
Summarise a fitted model
print(<thiessen>)
Print a fitted model
plot(<thiessen>)
Trace plots of a fitted model

Posterior and rstantools generics

as_draws_df(<thiessen>) as_draws_array(<thiessen>)
Posterior draws of a fitted model
ndraws(<thiessen>) nchains(<thiessen>)
Number of draws and chains of a fitted model
posterior_predict(<thiessen>)
Draw from the posterior predictive distribution
posterior_epred(<thiessen>)
Draw from the posterior distribution of the expected response
log_lik(<thiessen>)
Pointwise log-likelihood of a fitted model
predictive_interval(<thiessen>)
Central posterior predictive interval
reexports posterior_predict posterior_epred log_lik predictive_interval
Objects exported from other packages

Diagnostics

thiessen_diagnostics()
Per-draw sampler diagnostics of a fitted model
variable_inclusion()
Variable inclusion proportions of a fitted model

The sampler API

thiessen_sampler() experimental
Drive the sampler one call at a time
print(<thiessen_sampler>)
Print a sampler

core_version()
Version of the core crate
core_experimental()
Whether the core was built with its experimental feature
